# Agent Computers (`server/agent-computers/`)

Unified computer-use pool routing OpenMausBot agents across local AX, the 2nd Apple Silicon Mac (`lume` VMs + direct host), Cua Cloud Spaces, Daytona, and Orgo.ai.

## Files & Ownership

- `../../shared/agent-computers.ts` — Zod wire contracts, VM slug builder, and static 6-provider comparison catalog.
- `settings.ts` — Only reader of `CUA_API_KEY`, `DAYTONA_API_KEY`, `ORGO_API_KEY`, and endpoint URL overrides from `process.env`.
- `errors.ts` — `AgentComputerError(code, message, next, status)` loud error contract.
- `types.ts` — `ComputerProviderAdapter` interface and injectable HTTP/SSH transports.
- `store.ts` — Atomic persistence (`0600`) for host settings, burst policy, and active leases in `<DATA_DIR>/agent-computers.json`.
- `pool.ts` — `AgentComputerPool`: availability fan-out, lifecycle (`temporary` vs `long-term`), and cloud burst routing.
- `providers/*.ts` — Concrete adapters (`local-cua-ax`, `mac2-shared`, `mac2-lume-vm`, `cua-cloud`, `daytona`, `orgo`).
- `pool.test.ts` — Unit tests covering health diagnostics, VM clone/wipe vs persistent stop, and cloud burst fallback.

## Invariants

1. **Secrets stay in memory:** Never read `.env` files, log API keys, or persist auth headers in `agent-computers.json`. Inject cloud keys at runtime via `keys run`.
2. **Lifecycle discipline:** `temporary` leases (`tmp-<agentId>`) destroy their VM on session close; `long-term` leases (`a01-<role>-<project>`) snapshot/stop cleanly when idle.
3. **Apple Silicon macOS VM cap:** Never schedule more than 2 concurrent macOS VMs on `mac2-lume-vm` (Apple `Virtualization.framework` SLA); Linux VMs may fill remaining slots.
4. **Air-gapped Mac #2 private LAN transport (`old-mac`):** Gregorio's 2nd Mac (`MacBook-Air`, `gregorio@192.168.1.133`) is **strictly private Wi-Fi LAN-only and never online** (`Router: null`, `IPv6: Off`, `DNS: 127.0.0.1`, Tailscale/VPN/iPhone-USB OFF). Reach it two ways over IPv4 (`ssh old-mac` ↔ `ssh macbook-pro` at `192.168.1.108`, `AddressFamily inet`) and bridge `lume serve` (`127.0.0.1:7777`) via SSH local port forward (`ssh -fNL 7777:127.0.0.1:7777 old-mac`) rather than `tailscale serve`. Never enable internet or Tailscale on `MacBook-Air` without Gregorio's explicit approval (`/Users/g/External-Vault/A01__team/_shared/private-mac-ssh.md`).
5. **Verify:** `pnpm exec vitest run server/agent-computers/pool.test.ts && pnpm typecheck && bash -n scripts/setup-agent-mac.sh`
scripts/setup-agent-mac.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ==============================================================================
# setup-agent-mac.sh — 1-Command Secondary Apple Silicon Mac Bootstrap
# ==============================================================================
# Turns a freshly reset Apple Silicon Mac into a dedicated 24/7 Agent Computer
# Host for OpenMausBot:
#   1. mac2-lume-vm (#1 Primary): 2–4 concurrent isolated macOS/Linux VMs via
#      Cua `lume` (Apple Virtualization.framework) at $0/hr, zero cursor fight.
#   2. mac2-shared (Direct Host): Paired with OpenMausBot `shared-computers`
#      for bare-metal Xcode / Metal GPU / terminal workloads.
# ==============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_NAME="$(basename "$0")"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

LUME_PORT=7777
MACOS_BASE_VM="xlabs-macos-base"
LINUX_BASE_VM="xlabs-ubuntu-base"
MACOS_PULL_IMAGE="ghcr.io/trycua/macos-sequoia-cua:latest"
LINUX_PULL_IMAGE="ghcr.io/trycua/ubuntu-noble-cua:latest"

CUA_DRIVER_VERSION="0.28.2"
CUA_DRIVER_ARCHIVE="cua-driver-rs-${CUA_DRIVER_VERSION}-darwin-universal-binary.tar.gz"
CUA_DRIVER_URL="https://github.com/trycua/cua/releases/download/cua-driver-rs-v${CUA_DRIVER_VERSION}/${CUA_DRIVER_ARCHIVE}"
CUA_DRIVER_SHA256="386db225a3080714a0f9f935525e61efaf46709587ef8b94dd2df81aeb2f6daa"

LAUNCH_AGENT_LABEL="com.xlabs.agent-mac-host"
LAUNCH_AGENT_PLIST="${HOME}/Library/LaunchAgents/${LAUNCH_AGENT_LABEL}.plist"
HOST_SUPERVISOR_BIN="${HOME}/.local/libexec/xlabs-agent-mac-host.sh"
LOG_DIR="${HOME}/Library/Logs/xlabs-agent-mac"
SSHD_DROPIN="/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/90-xlabs-tailscale-only.conf"

DO_CHECK=false
DO_INSTALL=false
DO_INIT_VM_POOL=false
PAIR_URL=""
DRY_RUN=false

usage() {
  cat <<EOF
Usage: ${SCRIPT_NAME} [OPTIONS]

Bootstrap or verify a dedicated Apple Silicon Mac as an OpenMausBot Agent Computer Host.

Actions (combine one or more):
  --check                 Audit sleep guards, Tailscale, SSH, Lume, cua-driver, LaunchAgent & base VMs
  --install               Configure pmset sleep guards, Tailscale SSH, Lume, cua-driver & LaunchAgent
  --init-vm-pool          Prepare golden base VMs (${MACOS_BASE_VM} & ${LINUX_BASE_VM}) for instant cloning
  --pair-url <url>        Pair this Mac with OpenMausBot shared-computers and print host config JSON

Options:
  --lume-port <port>      Local Lume HTTP daemon port on 127.0.0.1 (default: ${LUME_PORT})
  --macos-base <name>     Golden macOS base VM name (default: ${MACOS_BASE_VM})
  --linux-base <name>     Golden Linux base VM name (default: ${LINUX_BASE_VM})
  --dry-run               Print mutating commands without executing them
  -h, --help              Show this help screen and exit 0

Examples:
  # 1. Audit current host readiness (safe, read-only)
  ./scripts/${SCRIPT_NAME} --check

  # 2. Full 1-command bootstrap on Gregorio's reset 2nd Mac
  ./scripts/${SCRIPT_NAME} --install --init-vm-pool --pair-url "https://omb.tailnet.ts.net/pair/..."
EOF
}

log_info()  { printf '[INFO]  %s\n' "$*"; }
log_ok()    { printf '[OK]    %s\n' "$*"; }
log_warn()  { printf '[WARN]  %s\n' "$*"; }
log_err()   { printf '[ERROR] %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

run_cmd() {
  if [[ "${DRY_RUN}" == "true" ]]; then
    printf '[DRY-RUN] %s\n' "$*"
    return 0
  fi
  "$@"
}

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --check)
      DO_CHECK=true
      shift
      ;;
    --install)
      DO_INSTALL=true
      shift
      ;;
    --init-vm-pool)
      DO_INIT_VM_POOL=true
      shift
      ;;
    --pair-url)
      if [[ $# -lt 2 || -z "${2:-}" ]]; then
        log_err "--pair-url requires a non-empty URL argument"
        exit 2
      fi
      PAIR_URL="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --lume-port)
      if [[ $# -lt 2 || ! "${2:-}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
        log_err "--lume-port requires a valid TCP port (1024-65535)"
        exit 2
      fi
      LUME_PORT="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --macos-base)
      MACOS_BASE_VM="${2:?--macos-base requires a VM name}"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --linux-base)
      LINUX_BASE_VM="${2:?--linux-base requires a VM name}"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --dry-run)
      DRY_RUN=true
      shift
      ;;
    -h|--help)
      usage
      exit 0
      ;;
    *)
      log_err "Unknown flag: $1 (run with --help for usage)"
      exit 2
      ;;
  esac
done

if [[ "${DO_CHECK}" == "false" && "${DO_INSTALL}" == "false" && "${DO_INIT_VM_POOL}" == "false" && -z "${PAIR_URL}" ]]; then
  usage
  exit 0
fi

find_tailscale_bin() {
  if command -v tailscale >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    command -v tailscale
  elif [[ -x "/Applications/Tailscale.app/Contents/MacOS/Tailscale" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "/Applications/Tailscale.app/Contents/MacOS/Tailscale"
  else
    return 1
  fi
}

get_tailscale_ipv4() {
  local ts_bin
  ts_bin="$(find_tailscale_bin 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [[ -z "${ts_bin}" ]]; then
    return 1
  fi
  "${ts_bin}" ip -4 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | tr -d '[:space:]'
}

get_tailscale_dns() {
  local ts_bin
  ts_bin="$(find_tailscale_bin 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [[ -z "${ts_bin}" ]]; then
    return 1
  fi
  "${ts_bin}" status --json 2>/dev/null \
    | /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print((d.get("Self",{}).get("DNSName") or "").rstrip("."))' 2>/dev/null || true
}

find_cua_driver_bin() {
  for candidate in "/usr/local/bin/cua-driver" "${HOME}/.local/bin/cua-driver" "/Applications/CuaDriver.app/Contents/MacOS/cua-driver"; do
    if [[ -x "${candidate}" ]]; then
      printf '%s\n' "${candidate}"
      return 0
    fi
  done
  if command -v cua-driver >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    command -v cua-driver
    return 0
  fi
  return 1
}

find_lume_bin() {
  for candidate in "/opt/homebrew/bin/lume" "/usr/local/bin/lume" "${HOME}/.local/bin/lume"; do
    if [[ -x "${candidate}" ]]; then
      printf '%s\n' "${candidate}"
      return 0
    fi
  done
  if command -v lume >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    command -v lume
    return 0
  fi
  return 1
}

assert_apple_silicon() {
  local os_name arch_name
  os_name="$(uname -s)"
  arch_name="$(uname -m)"
  if [[ "${os_name}" != "Darwin" || "${arch_name}" != "arm64" ]]; then
    if [[ "${DRY_RUN}" == "true" ]]; then
      log_warn "Non-Apple-Silicon host (${os_name}/${arch_name}) allowed because --dry-run is active."
      return 0
    fi
    log_err "Apple Virtualization.framework (Lume) requires macOS on Apple Silicon (arm64); detected ${os_name}/${arch_name}."
    exit 1
  fi
}

configure_power_and_ssh() {
  log_info "Step 1/4: Configuring AC power sleep guards (pmset) & Tailscale-restricted SSH..."
  # Prevent system/disk sleep on AC power while allowing display to dim after 10 minutes.
  run_cmd sudo pmset -c sleep 0 disksleep 0 standby 0 autopoweroff 0 powernap 0 displaysleep 10 womp 1 autorestart 1

  local ts_ip=""
  ts_ip="$(get_tailscale_ipv4 || true)"
  if [[ -n "${ts_ip}" ]]; then
    log_info "Restricting sshd ListenAddress to Tailscale (${ts_ip}) and loopback (127.0.0.1)..."
    local dropin_content
    dropin_content="# Managed by OpenMausBot ${SCRIPT_NAME}
ListenAddress 127.0.0.1
ListenAddress ${ts_ip}
PasswordAuthentication no
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
PermitRootLogin no
"
    if [[ "${DRY_RUN}" == "true" ]]; then
      printf '[DRY-RUN] write %s (ListenAddress %s + 127.0.0.1)\n' "${SSHD_DROPIN}" "${ts_ip}"
    else
      sudo mkdir -p "$(dirname "${SSHD_DROPIN}")"
      printf '%s' "${dropin_content}" | sudo tee "${SSHD_DROPIN}" >/dev/null
      sudo chmod 0644 "${SSHD_DROPIN}"
      sudo systemsetup -setremotelogin on >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo launchctl load -w /System/Library/LaunchDaemons/ssh.plist >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
      sudo launchctl kickstart -k system/com.openssh.sshd >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi
    log_ok "SSH restricted to Tailscale IP ${ts_ip} + 127.0.0.1."
  else
    log_warn "Tailscale IPv4 not yet assigned; skipped sshd ListenAddress lock until 'tailscale up' completes."
  fi
}

install_dependencies() {
  log_info "Step 2/4: Installing/verifying Homebrew, Tailscale, Cua Lume, and cua-driver ${CUA_DRIVER_VERSION}..."

  if ! command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ ! -x /opt/homebrew/bin/brew ]]; then
    log_err "Homebrew is missing. Install Homebrew first: https://brew.sh"
    if [[ "${DRY_RUN}" != "true" ]]; then
      exit 1
    fi
  fi
  if [[ -x /opt/homebrew/bin/brew ]]; then
    eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"
  fi

  if ! find_tailscale_bin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log_info "Installing Tailscale via Homebrew..."
    run_cmd brew install --cask tailscale
  else
    log_ok "Tailscale binary present ($(find_tailscale_bin))."
  fi

  if ! find_lume_bin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log_info "Installing Cua Lume (trycua/lume)..."
    if ! run_cmd brew tap trycua/lume || ! run_cmd brew install trycua/lume/lume; then
      log_warn "Homebrew tap failed; falling back to official trycua Lume install script..."
      run_cmd /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trycua/cua/main/libs/lume/scripts/install.sh)"
    fi
  else
    log_ok "Lume CLI present ($(find_lume_bin))."
  fi

  local existing_cua=""
  existing_cua="$(find_cua_driver_bin || true)"
  local current_ver=""
  if [[ -n "${existing_cua}" ]]; then
    current_ver="$("${existing_cua}" --version 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}' || true)"
  fi

  if [[ "${current_ver}" == "${CUA_DRIVER_VERSION}" ]]; then
    log_ok "cua-driver ${CUA_DRIVER_VERSION} already installed at ${existing_cua}."
  else
    log_info "Installing checksum-verified cua-driver ${CUA_DRIVER_VERSION}..."
    run_cmd mkdir -p "${HOME}/.local/bin"
    if [[ "${DRY_RUN}" == "true" ]]; then
      printf '[DRY-RUN] download %s (sha256=%s) -> %s/.local/bin/cua-driver\n' \
        "${CUA_DRIVER_URL}" "${CUA_DRIVER_SHA256}" "${HOME}"
    else
      local tmp_dir
      tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
      trap 'rm -rf "${tmp_dir}"' EXIT
      curl -fsSL "${CUA_DRIVER_URL}" -o "${tmp_dir}/${CUA_DRIVER_ARCHIVE}"
      local actual_sha
      actual_sha="$(shasum -a 256 "${tmp_dir}/${CUA_DRIVER_ARCHIVE}" | awk '{print $1}')"
      if [[ "${actual_sha}" != "${CUA_DRIVER_SHA256}" ]]; then
        log_err "cua-driver SHA-256 mismatch! Expected ${CUA_DRIVER_SHA256}, got ${actual_sha}"
        exit 1
      fi
      /usr/bin/tar -xzf "${tmp_dir}/${CUA_DRIVER_ARCHIVE}" -C "${tmp_dir}" cua-driver
      install -m 0755 "${tmp_dir}/cua-driver" "${HOME}/.local/bin/cua-driver"
      if [[ -w "/usr/local/bin" ]]; then
        install -m 0755 "${tmp_dir}/cua-driver" "/usr/local/bin/cua-driver"
      fi
      rm -rf "${tmp_dir}"
      trap - EXIT
      log_ok "Installed cua-driver ${CUA_DRIVER_VERSION} to ${HOME}/.local/bin/cua-driver."
    fi
  fi
}

install_launch_agent() {
  log_info "Step 3/4: Installing LaunchAgent (${LAUNCH_AGENT_LABEL}) for Lume daemon on 127.0.0.1:${LUME_PORT}..."

  local lume_bin
  lume_bin="$(find_lume_bin || printf '%s' '/opt/homebrew/bin/lume')"

  run_cmd mkdir -p "$(dirname "${HOST_SUPERVISOR_BIN}")" "${HOME}/Library/LaunchAgents" "${LOG_DIR}"

  local supervisor_script="#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=\"/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:\${HOME}/.local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin\"
exec \"${lume_bin}\" serve --port ${LUME_PORT}
"

  local plist_xml="<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC \"-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN\" \"http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd\">
<plist version=\"1.0\">
<dict>
  <key>Label</key>
  <string>${LAUNCH_AGENT_LABEL}</string>
  <key>ProgramArguments</key>
  <array>
    <string>${HOST_SUPERVISOR_BIN}</string>
  </array>
  <key>RunAtLoad</key>
  <true/>
  <key>KeepAlive</key>
  <true/>
  <key>ThrottleInterval</key>
  <integer>5</integer>
  <key>StandardOutPath</key>
  <string>${LOG_DIR}/lume-serve.out.log</string>
  <key>StandardErrorPath</key>
  <string>${LOG_DIR}/lume-serve.err.log</string>
</dict>
</plist>
"

  if [[ "${DRY_RUN}" == "true" ]]; then
    printf '[DRY-RUN] write %s and %s, then launchctl bootstrap gui/%s\n' \
      "${HOST_SUPERVISOR_BIN}" "${LAUNCH_AGENT_PLIST}" "$(id -u)"
  else
    printf '%s' "${supervisor_script}" > "${HOST_SUPERVISOR_BIN}"
    chmod 0755 "${HOST_SUPERVISOR_BIN}"
    printf '%s' "${plist_xml}" > "${LAUNCH_AGENT_PLIST}"
    chmod 0644 "${LAUNCH_AGENT_PLIST}"

    launchctl bootout "gui/$(id -u)/${LAUNCH_AGENT_LABEL}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    launchctl bootstrap "gui/$(id -u)" "${LAUNCH_AGENT_PLIST}"
    launchctl kickstart -k "gui/$(id -u)/${LAUNCH_AGENT_LABEL}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi

  local ts_bin=""
  ts_bin="$(find_tailscale_bin || true)"
  if [[ -n "${ts_bin}" ]] && [[ -n "$(get_tailscale_ipv4 || true)" ]]; then
    log_info "Bridging 127.0.0.1:${LUME_PORT} exclusively onto Tailnet via 'tailscale serve'..."
    run_cmd "${ts_bin}" serve --bg --tcp "${LUME_PORT}" "tcp://127.0.0.1:${LUME_PORT}" || \
      log_warn "tailscale serve TCP bridge skipped (SSH tunnel transport remains ready on 127.0.0.1:${LUME_PORT})."
  fi

  log_ok "LaunchAgent ${LAUNCH_AGENT_LABEL} active (survives reboot, bound to 127.0.0.1:${LUME_PORT})."
}

init_vm_pool() {
  log_info "Step 4/4: Preparing Golden Base VM Templates (${MACOS_BASE_VM} & ${LINUX_BASE_VM})..."
  local lume_bin
  lume_bin="$(find_lume_bin || true)"
  if [[ -z "${lume_bin}" && "${DRY_RUN}" != "true" ]]; then
    log_err "lume CLI not found. Run with --install first."
    exit 1
  fi
  lume_bin="${lume_bin:-/opt/homebrew/bin/lume}"

  local existing_vms=""
  if [[ "${DRY_RUN}" != "true" ]]; then
    existing_vms="$("${lume_bin}" ls 2>/dev/null || true)"
  fi

  if grep -qE "(^|[[:space:]])${MACOS_BASE_VM}([[:space:]]|$)" <<<"${existing_vms}"; then
    log_ok "Golden macOS template '${MACOS_BASE_VM}' already exists."
  else
    log_info "Pulling prebuilt Cua macOS image into '${MACOS_BASE_VM}'..."
    if ! run_cmd "${lume_bin}" pull "${MACOS_PULL_IMAGE}" "${MACOS_BASE_VM}"; then
      log_warn "Prebuilt pull unavailable; creating unattended macOS IPSW base '${MACOS_BASE_VM}'..."
      run_cmd "${lume_bin}" create "${MACOS_BASE_VM}" --os macos --cpu 4 --memory 8GB --disk-size 50GB --ipsw latest
    fi
    run_cmd "${lume_bin}" stop "${MACOS_BASE_VM}" || true
    log_ok "Golden macOS template '${MACOS_BASE_VM}' ready for instant APFS copy-on-write cloning."
  fi

  if grep -qE "(^|[[:space:]])${LINUX_BASE_VM}([[:space:]]|$)" <<<"${existing_vms}"; then
    log_ok "Golden Linux template '${LINUX_BASE_VM}' already exists."
  else
    log_info "Pulling prebuilt Cua Ubuntu image into '${LINUX_BASE_VM}'..."
    if ! run_cmd "${lume_bin}" pull "${LINUX_PULL_IMAGE}" "${LINUX_BASE_VM}"; then
      log_warn "Prebuilt Linux pull unavailable; creating base Linux VM '${LINUX_BASE_VM}'..."
      run_cmd "${lume_bin}" create "${LINUX_BASE_VM}" --os linux --cpu 4 --memory 8GB --disk-size 40GB
    fi
    run_cmd "${lume_bin}" stop "${LINUX_BASE_VM}" || true
    log_ok "Golden Linux template '${LINUX_BASE_VM}' ready for instant APFS copy-on-write cloning."
  fi
}

pair_openmausbot() {
  local url="$1"
  log_info "Pairing this Mac with OpenMausBot shared-computers (${url})..."

  if [[ -f "${REPO_ROOT}/package.json" ]] && command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    run_cmd pnpm --dir "${REPO_ROOT}" pair "${url}" || \
      log_warn "Interactive pairing prompt required; complete approval in OpenMausBot UI."
  elif [[ -d "/Applications/OpenMausBot.app" ]]; then
    run_cmd open -a "/Applications/OpenMausBot.app" "${url}"
  else
    log_warn "OpenMausBot.app or repo checkout not found on Mac #2; install OpenMausBot.app and open: ${url}"
  fi

  local ts_dns ts_host ts_ip user_name
  ts_dns="$(get_tailscale_dns || true)"
  ts_ip="$(get_tailscale_ipv4 || true)"
  ts_host="${ts_dns:-${ts_ip:-mac2.tailnet.ts.net}}"
  user_name="$(id -un)"

  cat <<EOF

================================================================================
Primary Mac Configuration (<DATA_DIR>/agent-computers.json -> "mac2")
================================================================================
{
  "enabled": true,
  "name": "$(scutil --get ComputerName 2>/dev/null || hostname -s)",
  "tailscaleHost": "${ts_host}",
  "sshUser": "${user_name}",
  "lumePort": ${LUME_PORT},
  "lumeTransport": "http",
  "maxConcurrentVms": 3,
  "maxMacOsVms": 2,
  "macosBaseImage": "${MACOS_BASE_VM}",
  "linuxBaseImage": "${LINUX_BASE_VM}",
  "snapshotOnLongTermStop": true
}
================================================================================
EOF
}

run_check() {
  log_info "Auditing Agent Computer Host readiness..."
  local issues=0

  local os_name arch_name
  os_name="$(uname -s)"
  arch_name="$(uname -m)"
  if [[ "${os_name}" == "Darwin" && "${arch_name}" == "arm64" ]]; then
    log_ok "Hardware: Apple Silicon (${os_name}/${arch_name})"
  else
    log_warn "Hardware: ${os_name}/${arch_name} (Apple Silicon arm64 required for Lume)"
    issues=$((issues + 1))
  fi

  local ac_sleep
  ac_sleep="$(pmset -g custom 2>/dev/null | awk '/AC Power:/,/^$/' | awk '$1=="sleep"{print $2}' | head -n 1 || true)"
  if [[ "${ac_sleep}" == "0" ]]; then
    log_ok "Power guard: AC sleep disabled (sleep=0)"
  else
    log_warn "Power guard: AC sleep=${ac_sleep:-unknown} (run --install to set sleep=0)"
    issues=$((issues + 1))
  fi

  local ts_ip=""
  ts_ip="$(get_tailscale_ipv4 || true)"
  if [[ -n "${ts_ip}" ]]; then
    log_ok "Tailscale: connected (${ts_ip} / $(get_tailscale_dns || echo 'no-magicdns'))"
  else
    log_warn "Tailscale: offline or not installed"
    issues=$((issues + 1))
  fi

  if [[ -f "${SSHD_DROPIN}" ]]; then
    log_ok "SSH guard: ${SSHD_DROPIN} present"
  else
    log_warn "SSH guard: ${SSHD_DROPIN} missing (run --install)"
    issues=$((issues + 1))
  fi

  local lume_bin=""
  lume_bin="$(find_lume_bin || true)"
  if [[ -n "${lume_bin}" ]]; then
    log_ok "Lume CLI: ${lume_bin}"
  else
    log_warn "Lume CLI: missing (run --install)"
    issues=$((issues + 1))
  fi

  local cua_bin=""
  cua_bin="$(find_cua_driver_bin || true)"
  if [[ -n "${cua_bin}" ]]; then
    log_ok "cua-driver: ${cua_bin} ($("${cua_bin}" --version 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n' || echo 'unknown'))"
  else
    log_warn "cua-driver: missing (run --install)"
    issues=$((issues + 1))
  fi

  if [[ -f "${LAUNCH_AGENT_PLIST}" ]]; then
    log_ok "LaunchAgent: ${LAUNCH_AGENT_PLIST} installed"
  else
    log_warn "LaunchAgent: ${LAUNCH_AGENT_PLIST} missing (run --install)"
    issues=$((issues + 1))
  fi

  if curl -fsS --max-time 3 "http://127.0.0.1:${LUME_PORT}/lume/vms" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log_ok "Lume HTTP API: responding on http://127.0.0.1:${LUME_PORT}/lume/vms"
  else
    log_warn "Lume HTTP API: not responding on http://127.0.0.1:${LUME_PORT}/lume/vms"
    issues=$((issues + 1))
  fi

  if [[ -n "${lume_bin}" ]]; then
    local vms_out
    vms_out="$("${lume_bin}" ls 2>/dev/null || true)"
    for tpl in "${MACOS_BASE_VM}" "${LINUX_BASE_VM}"; do
      if grep -qE "(^|[[:space:]])${tpl}([[:space:]]|$)" <<<"${vms_out}"; then
        log_ok "Base VM template: ${tpl} ready"
      else
        log_warn "Base VM template: ${tpl} missing (run --init-vm-pool)"
        issues=$((issues + 1))
      fi
    done
  fi

  if [[ "${issues}" -eq 0 ]]; then
    log_ok "All host checks passed — Mac #2 is ready for mac2-lume-vm & mac2-shared!"
    return 0
  else
    log_warn "${issues} check(s) need attention. Run './scripts/${SCRIPT_NAME} --install --init-vm-pool' on Mac #2."
    return 1
  fi
}

if [[ "${DO_INSTALL}" == "true" || "${DO_INIT_VM_POOL}" == "true" ]]; then
  assert_apple_silicon
fi

if [[ "${DO_INSTALL}" == "true" ]]; then
  install_dependencies
  configure_power_and_ssh
  install_launch_agent
fi

if [[ "${DO_INIT_VM_POOL}" == "true" ]]; then
  init_vm_pool
fi

if [[ -n "${PAIR_URL}" ]]; then
  pair_openmausbot "${PAIR_URL}"
fi

if [[ "${DO_CHECK}" == "true" ]]; then
  run_check
fi

# Agent Computer Pool & Cua.ai Hypervisor Guide

Operational guide for running isolated agent computers in OpenMausBot across your local Mac, a dedicated 2nd Apple Silicon Mac (`lume` VM pool + direct host), Cua.ai Cloud Spaces, Daytona, and Orgo.ai.

## 1. Architecture Overview

```text
OpenMausBot Primary Mac (Gs-MacBook-Pro · 192.168.1.108 · online)
  └── AgentComputerPool (server/agent-computers/pool.ts)
        ├── #1 mac2-lume-vm   ──▶ 2nd Mac Cua Lume Hypervisor (ssh -fNL 7777:127.0.0.1:7777 old-mac · 2–4 VMs, $0/hr)
        ├── #2 local-cua-ax   ──▶ This Mac Embedded Cua Driver (background AX tree, $0/hr, ~4ms socket)
        ├── #3 mac2-shared    ──▶ 2nd Mac Direct Host (Private LAN SSH old-mac 192.168.1.133, bare-metal GPU/Xcode)
        ├── #4 cua-cloud      ──▶ Cua.ai Cloud Spaces (macOS / Linux / Windows GUI desktops, CUA_API_KEY)
        ├── #5 daytona        ──▶ Daytona Cloud Sandboxes (~300ms Linux CLI/headless burst, DAYTONA_API_KEY)
        └── #6 orgo           ──▶ Orgo.ai Cloud Computers (persistent Ubuntu GUI + /computers API, ORGO_API_KEY)
```

Every provider sits behind `ComputerProviderAdapter` (`server/agent-computers/types.ts`) with seven uniform operations:
- `checkAvailability` — live readiness, active slot count, OS support, and next-step diagnostics (`missing_api_key`, `host_offline`, `capacity_full`).
- `provisionOrLease` — clones, wakes, or attaches an isolated computer according to `temporary` vs `long-term` mode.
- `execCommand` — executes shell commands in a clean environment (`env -i` without host daemon secrets).
- `mcpEndpoint` — returns the live `--mcp-config` descriptor (`cua-driver mcp`, streamable HTTP, or REST bridge).
- `screenshotPreview` — returns a base64 PNG/JPEG preview plus any Tailscale/cloud VNC stream URL.
- `pauseOrStop` — stops compute cleanly (snapshotting `long-term` Lume VMs when configured).
- `destroyLease` — stops and wipes ephemeral sandboxes/VMs idempotently.

---

## 2. Provider Comparison

| Rank | Provider ID | OS Support | Isolation | Max Concurrency | Cold Start / Action Latency | Cost | Cursor Conflict | Best Use Case |
|---:|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | `mac2-lume-vm` | macOS, Linux | Full VM per agent (Apple `Virtualization.framework`) | **2–4 VMs** _(max 2 macOS + 2 Linux)_ | ~4.5s APFS clone · ~18ms LAN | **$0.00/hr** | No | Primary isolated GUI/browser/code desktop per agent |
| **2** | `local-cua-ax` | Host OS (macOS) | Shared host via PID-targeted AX tree | 1–4 background apps | 0s warm · ~4ms socket | **$0.00/hr** | No _(AX path)_ | Quick tasks on local apps already open on your main Mac |
| **3** | `mac2-shared` | macOS | Bare-metal host OS | 1 GUI agent + shell jobs | 0s warm · ~15ms LAN | **$0.00/hr** | Yes _(1 host cursor)_ | Heavy Metal GPU renders, local Xcode builds, shared folders |
| **4** | `cua-cloud` | macOS, Linux, Windows | Cloud VM per agent | 50+ Spaces | ~6s wake · ~85ms WAN | ~$0.15–$0.45/hr | No | Overflow macOS/Linux GUI capacity or Windows-only apps |
| **5** | `daytona` | Linux | Cloud container sandbox | 100+ sandboxes | **~300ms** · ~45ms API | **~$0.05/vCPU-hr** | No | High-parallelism Linux CLI, code builds, headless scraping |
| **6** | `orgo` | Linux (Ubuntu) | Cloud GUI VM per agent | 50+ VMs | ~2.5s boot · ~70ms API | ~$0.12/hr | No | Persistent Ubuntu GUI desktops via `/computers` REST API |

> **Apple Virtualization.framework 2-macOS-VM Rule:** Apple's macOS SLA enforces a hard kernel limit of **2 concurrent macOS guest VMs** per physical Apple Silicon Mac. Linux VMs (`xlabs-ubuntu-base`) do not count against that 2-VM cap. On a 32GB+ 2nd Mac, `AgentComputerPool` runs up to **2 macOS VMs + 2 Ubuntu VMs concurrently at $0/hr**, and bursts any 3rd concurrent macOS request to `cua-cloud`.

---

## 3. Secondary Mac Setup (Live Air-Gapped Private LAN vs Optional Tailscale)

### 3A. Live Production Mode: Air-Gapped Private Wi-Fi LAN (`MacBook-Air` — Never Online)

Gregorio's 2nd Mac (`MacBook-Air`, user `gregorio`) runs **strictly on private Wi-Fi LAN (`192.168.1.0/24`) with zero internet access**:

- **Primary Mac (`Gs-MacBook-Pro`, user `g`):** `192.168.1.108/24` (DHCP, online) -> `ssh old-mac` (or `ssh macbook-air` / `ssh mba`).
- **Secondary Mac (`MacBook-Air`, user `gregorio`):** `192.168.1.133/24` (Manual, **never online**) -> `ssh macbook-pro` (or `ssh mbp` / `ssh new-mac`).
- **Air-Gap Invariants on `MacBook-Air`:** `Router: (null)`, `IPv6: Off` (`networksetup -setv6off "Wi-Fi"`), `DNS: 127.0.0.1`, `*Tailscale` / `*Surfshark` / `*iPhone USB` disabled, and `AddressFamily inet` direct IPv4 in `~/.ssh/config` (never `.local` mDNS).
- **Lume API Bridge (`mac2-lume-vm` without Tailscale):** Forward `lume serve` (`127.0.0.1:7777` on `MacBook-Air`) over SSH from `Gs-MacBook-Pro`:
  ```bash
  ssh -fNL 7777:127.0.0.1:7777 old-mac
  curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:7777/lume/vms
  ```
- **`<DATA_DIR>/agent-computers.json` block for Air-Gapped Private LAN:**
  ```json
  {
    "mac2": {
      "sshAlias": "old-mac",
      "host": "192.168.1.133",
      "lumeApiUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:7777",
      "macosBaseVm": "xlabs-macos-base",
      "linuxBaseVm": "xlabs-ubuntu-base",
      "maxMacosVms": 2,
      "maxTotalVms": 4
    }
  }
  ```
- **One-Time Online Window for Pulling Base VM Images (Only With Gregorio's Explicit Approval):**
  ```bash
  # 1. Unlock internet temporarily on MacBook Air
  ssh old-mac 'networksetup -setdhcp "Wi-Fi" && networksetup -setv6automatic "Wi-Fi" && networksetup -setdnsservers "Wi-Fi" "Empty"'

  # 2. Run setup-agent-mac.sh / pull trycua base images ...

  # 3. IMMEDIATELY re-lock MacBook Air offline (LAN-only) & verify 0 WAN routes
  ssh old-mac 'networksetup -setv6off "Wi-Fi" && networksetup -setdnsservers "Wi-Fi" 127.0.0.1 && networksetup -setmanual "Wi-Fi" 192.168.1.133 255.255.255.0 ""'
  ssh old-mac 'hostname && ssh macbook-pro hostname && ! ping -c 1 -t 2 1.1.1.1 && ! ping6 -c 1 2606:4700:4700::1111'
  ```

### 3B. 1-Command Reset Secondary Mac Bootstrap (`setup-agent-mac.sh`)

When initially bootstrapping a freshly reset 2nd Apple Silicon Mac (during an approved online window or Tailscale mode):

### Step 1: Audit Current Readiness (Read-Only)

```bash
./scripts/setup-agent-mac.sh --check
```

### Step 2: Run the 1-Command Bootstrap

```bash
./scripts/setup-agent-mac.sh \
  --install \
  --init-vm-pool \
  --pair-url "https://<your-openmausbot-pair-url>"
```

What `setup-agent-mac.sh` configures idempotently:
1. **AC Sleep Guards (`pmset`):** Disables system sleep, disk sleep, standby, and autopoweroff on AC power (`sleep 0 disksleep 0 standby 0 autopoweroff 0 womp 1 autorestart 1`) while letting the display dim after 10 minutes (`displaysleep 10`).
2. **Tailscale-Restricted SSH:** Installs/verifies Tailscale and writes `/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/90-xlabs-tailscale-only.conf` binding `sshd` strictly to `127.0.0.1` and the Mac's `100.x.y.z` Tailscale IP (`PasswordAuthentication no`).
3. **Cua `lume` + Checksummed `cua-driver`:** Installs `trycua/lume` and the SHA-256 verified universal `cua-driver` `0.28.2` binary (`~/.local/bin/cua-driver` / `/usr/local/bin/cua-driver`).
4. **Reboot-Persistent LaunchAgent (`com.xlabs.agent-mac-host`):** Runs `lume serve --port 7777` on `127.0.0.1:7777` with `KeepAlive: true` and bridges port `7777` onto your private Tailnet via `tailscale serve`.
5. **Golden Base Templates (`--init-vm-pool`):** Prepares `xlabs-macos-base` and `xlabs-ubuntu-base` in a clean stopped state so `lume clone` creates isolated agent VMs in seconds using zero-extra-space APFS copy-on-write clones.
6. **Dual-Mode OpenMausBot Pairing (`--pair-url`):** Pairs Mac #2 with `SharedComputers` (`mac2-shared`) and prints the exact `mac2` JSON block for `<DATA_DIR>/agent-computers.json` on your primary Mac.

---

## 4. Agent Lifecycle Modes (`temporary` vs `long-term`)

Every lease request specifies `mode`:

| Mode | Naming Pattern | Provisioning Behavior | On `pool.closeSession(leaseId)` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `temporary` | `tmp-<agentId>` | Deletes any stale `tmp-<agentId>`, clones fresh from golden base (`xlabs-macos-base` / `xlabs-ubuntu-base`), starts headless | Calls `destroyLease()` -> stops and deletes VM (`DELETE /lume/vms/tmp-<agentId>`), reclaiming disk immediately |
| `long-term` | `a01-<role>-<project>` | Reuses existing persistent VM if present (waking it cleanly), or clones once on first run | Calls `pauseOrStop()` -> stops VM (`POST /lume/vms/.../stop`) and updates `-snap` APFS clone so browser sessions, files, and tools persist at 0 CPU/RAM |

---

## 5. Cloud Burst & Secret Management

Never store API keys in `.env` files or in `<DATA_DIR>/agent-computers.json`. Inject cloud burst credentials at runtime from Bitwarden Secrets Manager via `keys run`:

```bash
keys run stable -- pnpm dev:server
```

Environment variables read exclusively by `server/agent-computers/settings.ts`:
- `CUA_API_KEY` — enables `cua-cloud` (macOS, Linux, Windows Spaces; optional `CUA_API_URL`).
- `DAYTONA_API_KEY` — enables `daytona` sub-second Linux burst sandboxes (optional `DAYTONA_API_URL`).
- `ORGO_API_KEY` — enables `orgo` persistent Ubuntu GUI VMs (optional `ORGO_API_URL`).

When a cloud key is absent, the pool never crashes: `checkAvailability` reports `state: "missing_credentials"`, `reasonCode: "missing_api_key"`, and an exact `nextStep` command.

---

## 6. Module Integration Quickstart (Wave 2 Wiring)

```ts
import { createDefaultAgentComputerPool } from "./agent-computers/index.ts";

const pool = createDefaultAgentComputerPool({ desktop: desktopComputer, sharedComputers });

// 1. Picker catalog + live health status
const providers = await pool.listProvidersWithStatus();

// 2. Lease an isolated computer (defaults to #1 mac2-lume-vm, bursts to cloud if full)
const lease = await pool.acquireComputer({
  agentId: "scout-01",
  mode: "temporary",
  os: "macos",
  needsGui: true,
});

// 3. Inject MCP server into bot --mcp-config (in-memory only, never persisted)
const mcp = await pool.getMcpEndpoint(lease.leaseId);

// 4. Close session (wipes temporary tmp-scout-01; stops & snapshots long-term a01-* VMs)
await pool.closeSession(lease.leaseId);
```
